## Cormotif Function Script

```{r Cormotif Script}
## Fit limma model using code as it is found in the original cormotif code. It has
## only been modified to add names to the matrix of t values, as well as the
## limma fits

# This is creating a function of baseR limma defaults
limmafit.default <- function(exprs,groupid,compid) {
  limmafits  <- list()
  compnum    <- nrow(compid)
  genenum    <- nrow(exprs)
  limmat     <- matrix(0,genenum,compnum)
  limmas2    <- rep(0,compnum)
  limmadf    <- rep(0,compnum)
  limmav0    <- rep(0,compnum)
  limmag1num <- rep(0,compnum)
  limmag2num <- rep(0,compnum)

  rownames(limmat)  <- rownames(exprs)
  colnames(limmat)  <- rownames(compid)
  names(limmas2)    <- rownames(compid)
  names(limmadf)    <- rownames(compid)
  names(limmav0)    <- rownames(compid)
  names(limmag1num) <- rownames(compid)
  names(limmag2num) <- rownames(compid)
# This is creating a comparison loop for each comparison provided
  for(i in 1:compnum) {
    selid1 <- which(groupid == compid[i,1])
    selid2 <- which(groupid == compid[i,2])
    eset   <- new("ExpressionSet", exprs=cbind(exprs[,selid1],exprs[,selid2]))
    g1num  <- length(selid1)
    g2num  <- length(selid2)
    designmat <- cbind(base=rep(1,(g1num+g2num)), delta=c(rep(0,g1num),rep(1,g2num)))
    fit <- lmFit(eset,designmat)
    fit <- eBayes(fit)
    limmat[,i] <- fit$t[,2]
    limmas2[i] <- fit$s2.prior
    limmadf[i] <- fit$df.prior
    limmav0[i] <- fit$var.prior[2]
    limmag1num[i] <- g1num
    limmag2num[i] <- g2num
    limmafits[[i]] <- fit

    # log odds
    # w<-sqrt(1+fit$var.prior[2]/(1/g1num+1/g2num))
    # log(0.99)+dt(fit$t[1,2],g1num+g2num-2+fit$df.prior,log=TRUE)-log(0.01)-dt(fit$t[1,2]/w, g1num+g2num-2+fit$df.prior, log=TRUE)+log(w)
  }
  names(limmafits) <- rownames(compid)
  limmacompnum<-nrow(compid)
  result<-list(t       = limmat,
               v0      = limmav0,
               df0     = limmadf,
               s20     = limmas2,
               g1num   = limmag1num,
               g2num   = limmag2num,
               compnum = limmacompnum,
               fits    = limmafits)
}

# Applying above defaults to raw log2 cpm counts ???
limmafit.counts <-
  function (exprs, groupid, compid, norm.factor.method = "TMM", voom.normalize.method = "none")
  {
    limmafits  <- list()
    compnum    <- nrow(compid)
    genenum    <- nrow(exprs)
    limmat     <- matrix(NA,genenum,compnum)
    limmas2    <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmadf    <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmav0    <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmag1num <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmag2num <- rep(0,compnum)

    rownames(limmat)  <- rownames(exprs)
    colnames(limmat)  <- rownames(compid)
    names(limmas2)    <- rownames(compid)
    names(limmadf)    <- rownames(compid)
    names(limmav0)    <- rownames(compid)
    names(limmag1num) <- rownames(compid)
    names(limmag2num) <- rownames(compid)

    for (i in 1:compnum) {
      message(paste("Running limma for comparision",i,"/",compnum))
      selid1 <- which(groupid == compid[i, 1])
      selid2 <- which(groupid == compid[i, 2])
      # make a new count data frame
      counts <- cbind(exprs[, selid1], exprs[, selid2])

      # remove NAs
      not.nas <- which(apply(counts, 1, function(x) !any(is.na(x))) == TRUE)

      # runn voom/limma
      d <- DGEList(counts[not.nas,])
      d <- calcNormFactors(d, method = norm.factor.method)
      g1num <- length(selid1)
      g2num <- length(selid2)
      designmat <- cbind(base = rep(1, (g1num + g2num)), delta = c(rep(0,
                                                                       g1num), rep(1, g2num)))

      y <- voom(d, designmat, normalize.method = voom.normalize.method)
      fit <- lmFit(y, designmat)
      fit <- eBayes(fit)

      limmafits[[i]] <- fit
      limmat[not.nas, i] <- fit$t[, 2]
      limmas2[i] <- fit$s2.prior
      limmadf[i] <- fit$df.prior
      limmav0[i] <- fit$var.prior[2]
      limmag1num[i] <- g1num
      limmag2num[i] <- g2num
    }
    limmacompnum <- nrow(compid)
    names(limmafits) <- rownames(compid)
    result <- list(t       = limmat,
                   v0      = limmav0,
                   df0     = limmadf,
                   s20     = limmas2,
                   g1num   = limmag1num,
                   g2num   = limmag2num,
                   compnum = limmacompnum,
                   fits    = limmafits)
  }

limmafit.list <-
  function (fitlist, cmp.idx=2)
  {
    compnum    <- length(fitlist)

    genes <- c()
    for (i in 1:compnum) genes <- unique(c(genes, rownames(fitlist[[i]])))

    genenum    <- length(genes)
    limmat     <- matrix(NA,genenum,compnum)
    limmas2    <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmadf    <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmav0    <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmag1num <- rep(0,compnum)
    limmag2num <- rep(0,compnum)

    rownames(limmat)  <- genes
    colnames(limmat)  <- names(fitlist)
    names(limmas2)    <- names(fitlist)
    names(limmadf)    <- names(fitlist)
    names(limmav0)    <- names(fitlist)
    names(limmag1num) <- names(fitlist)
    names(limmag2num) <- names(fitlist)

    for (i in 1:compnum) {
      this.t <- fitlist[[i]]$t[,cmp.idx]
      limmat[names(this.t),i] <- this.t

      limmas2[i]    <- fitlist[[i]]$s2.prior
      limmadf[i]    <- fitlist[[i]]$df.prior
      limmav0[i]    <- fitlist[[i]]$var.prior[cmp.idx]
      limmag1num[i] <- sum(fitlist[[i]]$design[,cmp.idx]==0)
      limmag2num[i] <- sum(fitlist[[i]]$design[,cmp.idx]==1)
    }

    limmacompnum <- compnum
    result <- list(t       = limmat,
                   v0      = limmav0,
                   df0     = limmadf,
                   s20     = limmas2,
                   g1num   = limmag1num,
                   g2num   = limmag2num,
                   compnum = limmacompnum,
                   fits    = limmafits)

  }

## Ranking genes based on t-statistics, used to identify the strongest responders
generank<-function(x) {
  xcol<-ncol(x)
  xrow<-nrow(x)
  result<-matrix(0,xrow,xcol)
  z<-(1:1:xrow)
  for(i in 1:xcol) {
    y<-sort(x[,i],decreasing=TRUE,na.last=TRUE)
    result[,i]<-match(x[,i],y)
    result[,i]<-order(result[,i])
  }
  result
}

## Log-likelihood for moderated t under H0 to ask what is the probability of observing this t-statistic if the gene has no effect? Equation of P(t∣H0)
modt.f0.loglike<-function(x,df) {
  a<-dt(x, df, log=TRUE)
  result<-as.vector(a)
  flag<-which(is.na(result)==TRUE)
  result[flag]<-0
  result
}

## Log-likelihood for moderated t under H1 to ask what is the probability of this t-statistic if the gene is truly responding? Equation of P(t∣H1). The quotient of P(t|H1)/P(t|H0) determines motif membership
## param=c(df,g1num,g2num,v0)
modt.f1.loglike<-function(x,param) {
  df<-param[1]
  g1num<-param[2]
  g2num<-param[3]
  v0<-param[4]
  w<-sqrt(1+v0/(1/g1num+1/g2num))
  dt(x/w, df, log=TRUE)-log(w)
  a<-dt(x/w, df, log=TRUE)-log(w)
  result<-as.vector(a)
  flag<-which(is.na(result)==TRUE)
  result[flag]<-0
  result
}

## Correlation Motif Fit, the heart of Cormotif, fits correlation motifs for number of motifs, 'k', so when k=3, the code is being told to find three groups of correlated responses
cmfit.X<-function(x, type, K=1, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100) {
  ## initializing motif probabilities and creating random probabilities, where values closer to 1 for a certain motif indicates that motif has a high likelihood of activation in a particular condition
  xrow <- nrow(x)
  xcol <- ncol(x)
  loglike0 <- list()
  loglike1 <- list()
  p <- rep(1, K)/K
  q <- matrix(runif(K * xcol), K, xcol)
  q[1, ] <- rep(0.01, xcol)
  for (i in 1:xcol) {
    f0 <- type[[i]][[1]]
    f0param <- type[[i]][[2]]
    f1 <- type[[i]][[3]]
    f1param <- type[[i]][[4]]
    loglike0[[i]] <- f0(x[, i], f0param)
    loglike1[[i]] <- f1(x[, i], f1param)
  }
  condlike <- list()
  for (i in 1:xcol) {
    condlike[[i]] <- matrix(0, xrow, K)
  }
  loglike.old <- -1e+10
  ## Big loop for EM optimization
  for (i.iter in 1:max.iter) {
    if ((i.iter%%50) == 0) {
      print(paste("We have run the first ", i.iter, " iterations for K=",
                  K, sep = ""))
    }
    err <- tol + 1
    ## E step of EM, contains probabilities that calculate given the current motifs, what genes belong to each motif
    clustlike <- matrix(0, xrow, K)
    #templike <- matrix(0, xrow, 2)
    templike1 <- rep(0, xrow)
    templike2 <- rep(0, xrow)
    for (j in 1:K) {
      for (i in 1:xcol) {
        templike1 <- log(q[j, i]) + loglike1[[i]]
        templike2 <- log(1 - q[j, i]) + loglike0[[i]]
        tempmax <- Rfast::Pmax(templike1, templike2)

        templike1 <- exp(templike1 - tempmax)
        templike2 <- exp(templike2 - tempmax)

        tempsum <- templike1 + templike2
        clustlike[, j] <- clustlike[, j] + tempmax +
          log(tempsum)
        condlike[[i]][, j] <- templike1/tempsum
      }
      clustlike[, j] <- clustlike[, j] + log(p[j])
    }
    #tempmax <- apply(clustlike, 1, max)
    tempmax <- Rfast::rowMaxs(clustlike, value=TRUE)
    for (j in 1:K) {
      clustlike[, j] <- exp(clustlike[, j] - tempmax)
    }
    #tempsum <- apply(clustlike, 1, sum)
    tempsum <- Rfast::rowsums(clustlike)
    for (j in 1:K) {
      clustlike[, j] <- clustlike[, j]/tempsum
    }
    ## M step of EM, updates motif frequency and pattern to illustrate updates to motif abundance via p.new and to motif structure via q.new 
    #p.new <- (apply(clustlike, 2, sum) + 1)/(xrow + K)
    p.new <- (Rfast::colsums(clustlike) + 1)/(xrow + K)
    q.new <- matrix(0, K, xcol)
    for (j in 1:K) {
      clustpsum <- sum(clustlike[, j])
      for (i in 1:xcol) {
        q.new[j, i] <- (sum(clustlike[, j] * condlike[[i]][,
                                                           j]) + 1)/(clustpsum + 2)
      }
    }
    err.p <- max(abs(p.new - p)/p)
    err.q <- max(abs(q.new - q)/q)
    err <- max(err.p, err.q)
    loglike.new <- (sum(tempmax + log(tempsum)) + sum(log(p.new)) +
                      sum(log(q.new) + log(1 - q.new)))/xrow
    p <- p.new
    q <- q.new
    loglike.old <- loglike.new
    ## The p.new and q.new loop breaks until err < tol, indicating that motif assignments are no longer changing
    if (err < tol) {
      break
    }
  }
  clustlike <- matrix(0, xrow, K)
  for (j in 1:K) {
    for (i in 1:xcol) {
      templike1 <- log(q[j, i]) + loglike1[[i]]
      templike2 <- log(1 - q[j, i]) + loglike0[[i]]
      tempmax <- Rfast::Pmax(templike1, templike2)

      templike1 <- exp(templike1 - tempmax)
      templike2 <- exp(templike2 - tempmax)

      tempsum <- templike1 + templike2
      clustlike[, j] <- clustlike[, j] + tempmax + log(tempsum)
      condlike[[i]][, j] <- templike1/tempsum
    }
    clustlike[, j] <- clustlike[, j] + log(p[j])
  }
  #tempmax <- apply(clustlike, 1, max)
  tempmax <- Rfast::rowMaxs(clustlike, value=TRUE)
  for (j in 1:K) {
    clustlike[, j] <- exp(clustlike[, j] - tempmax)
  }
  #tempsum <- apply(clustlike, 1, sum)
  tempsum <- Rfast::rowsums(clustlike)
  for (j in 1:K) {
    clustlike[, j] <- clustlike[, j]/tempsum
  }
  p.post <- matrix(0, xrow, xcol)
  for (j in 1:K) {
    for (i in 1:xcol) {
      p.post[, i] <- p.post[, i] + clustlike[, j] * condlike[[i]][,
                                                                  j]
    }
  }
  loglike.old <- loglike.old - (sum(log(p)) + sum(log(q) +
                                                    log(1 - q)))/xrow
  loglike.old <- loglike.old * xrow
  result <- list(p.post = p.post, motif.prior = p, motif.q = q,
                 loglike = loglike.old, clustlike=clustlike, condlike=condlike)
}

## Fit using (0,0,...,0) and (1,1,...,1)
cmfitall<-function(x, type, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100) {
  ## initialize
  xrow<-nrow(x)
  xcol<-ncol(x)
  loglike0<-list()
  loglike1<-list()
  p<-0.01

  ## compute loglikelihood
  L0<-matrix(0,xrow,1)
  L1<-matrix(0,xrow,1)
  for(i in 1:xcol) {
    f0<-type[[i]][[1]]
    f0param<-type[[i]][[2]]
    f1<-type[[i]][[3]]
    f1param<-type[[i]][[4]]
    loglike0[[i]]<-f0(x[,i],f0param)
    loglike1[[i]]<-f1(x[,i],f1param)
    L0<-L0+loglike0[[i]]
    L1<-L1+loglike1[[i]]
  }


  ## EM algorithm to get MLE of p and q
  loglike.old <- -1e10
  for(i.iter in 1:max.iter) {
    if((i.iter%%50) == 0) {
      print(paste("We have run the first ", i.iter, " iterations",sep=""))
    }
    err<-tol+1

    ## compute posterior cluster membership
    clustlike<-matrix(0,xrow,2)
    clustlike[,1]<-log(1-p)+L0
    clustlike[,2]<-log(p)+L1

    tempmax<-apply(clustlike,1,max)
    for(j in 1:2) {
      clustlike[,j]<-exp(clustlike[,j]-tempmax)
    }
    tempsum<-apply(clustlike,1,sum)


    ## update motif occurrence rate
    for(j in 1:2) {
      clustlike[,j]<-clustlike[,j]/tempsum
    }

    p.new<-(sum(clustlike[,2])+1)/(xrow+2)

    ## evaluate convergence
    err<-abs(p.new-p)/p


    ## evaluate whether the log.likelihood increases
    loglike.new<-(sum(tempmax+log(tempsum))+log(p.new)+log(1-p.new))/xrow

    loglike.old<-loglike.new
    p<-p.new

    if(err<tol) {
      break;
    }
  }

  ## compute posterior p
  clustlike<-matrix(0,xrow,2)
  clustlike[,1]<-log(1-p)+L0
  clustlike[,2]<-log(p)+L1

  tempmax<-apply(clustlike,1,max)
  for(j in 1:2) {
    clustlike[,j]<-exp(clustlike[,j]-tempmax)
  }
  tempsum<-apply(clustlike,1,sum)

  for(j in 1:2) {
    clustlike[,j]<-clustlike[,j]/tempsum
  }

  p.post<-matrix(0,xrow,xcol)
  for(i in 1:xcol) {
    p.post[,i]<-clustlike[,2]
  }

  ## return

  #calculate back loglikelihood
  loglike.old<-loglike.old-(log(p)+log(1-p))/xrow
  loglike.old<-loglike.old*xrow
  result<-list(p.post=p.post, motif.prior=p, loglike=loglike.old)
}

## Fit each dataset separately
cmfitsep<-function(x, type, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100) {
  ## initialize
  xrow<-nrow(x)
  xcol<-ncol(x)
  loglike0<-list()
  loglike1<-list()
  p<-0.01*rep(1,xcol)
  loglike.final<-rep(0,xcol)

  ## compute loglikelihood
  for(i in 1:xcol) {
    f0<-type[[i]][[1]]
    f0param<-type[[i]][[2]]
    f1<-type[[i]][[3]]
    f1param<-type[[i]][[4]]
    loglike0[[i]]<-f0(x[,i],f0param)
    loglike1[[i]]<-f1(x[,i],f1param)
  }

  p.post<-matrix(0,xrow,xcol)

  ## EM algorithm to get MLE of p
  for(coli in 1:xcol) {
    loglike.old <- -1e10
    for(i.iter in 1:max.iter) {
      if((i.iter%%50) == 0) {
        print(paste("We have run the first ", i.iter, " iterations",sep=""))
      }
      err<-tol+1

      ## compute posterior cluster membership
      clustlike<-matrix(0,xrow,2)
      clustlike[,1]<-log(1-p[coli])+loglike0[[coli]]
      clustlike[,2]<-log(p[coli])+loglike1[[coli]]

      tempmax<-apply(clustlike,1,max)
      for(j in 1:2) {
        clustlike[,j]<-exp(clustlike[,j]-tempmax)
      }
      tempsum<-apply(clustlike,1,sum)

      ## evaluate whether the log.likelihood increases
      loglike.new<-sum(tempmax+log(tempsum))/xrow

      ## update motif occurrence rate
      for(j in 1:2) {
        clustlike[,j]<-clustlike[,j]/tempsum
      }

      p.new<-(sum(clustlike[,2]))/(xrow)

      ## evaluate convergence
      err<-abs(p.new-p[coli])/p[coli]
      loglike.old<-loglike.new
      p[coli]<-p.new

      if(err<tol) {
        break;
      }
    }

    ## compute posterior p
    clustlike<-matrix(0,xrow,2)
    clustlike[,1]<-log(1-p[coli])+loglike0[[coli]]
    clustlike[,2]<-log(p[coli])+loglike1[[coli]]

    tempmax<-apply(clustlike,1,max)
    for(j in 1:2) {
      clustlike[,j]<-exp(clustlike[,j]-tempmax)
    }
    tempsum<-apply(clustlike,1,sum)

    for(j in 1:2) {
      clustlike[,j]<-clustlike[,j]/tempsum
    }

    p.post[,coli]<-clustlike[,2]
    loglike.final[coli]<-loglike.old
  }


  ## return
  loglike.final<-loglike.final*xrow
  result<-list(p.post=p.post, motif.prior=p, loglike=loglike.final)
}

## Fit the full model
cmfitfull<-function(x, type, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100) {
  ## initialize
  xrow<-nrow(x)
  xcol<-ncol(x)
  loglike0<-list()
  loglike1<-list()
  K<-2^xcol
  p<-rep(1,K)/K
  pattern<-rep(0,xcol)
  patid<-matrix(0,K,xcol)

  ## compute loglikelihood
  for(i in 1:xcol) {
    f0<-type[[i]][[1]]
    f0param<-type[[i]][[2]]
    f1<-type[[i]][[3]]
    f1param<-type[[i]][[4]]
    loglike0[[i]]<-f0(x[,i],f0param)
    loglike1[[i]]<-f1(x[,i],f1param)
  }
  L<-matrix(0,xrow,K)
  for(i in 1:K)
  {
    patid[i,]<-pattern
    for(j in 1:xcol) {
      if(pattern[j] < 0.5) {
        L[,i]<-L[,i]+loglike0[[j]]
      } else {
        L[,i]<-L[,i]+loglike1[[j]]
      }
    }

    if(i < K) {
      pattern[xcol]<-pattern[xcol]+1
      j<-xcol
      while(pattern[j] > 1) {
        pattern[j]<-0
        j<-j-1
        pattern[j]<-pattern[j]+1
      }
    }
  }

  ## EM algorithm to get MLE of p and q
  loglike.old <- -1e10
  for(i.iter in 1:max.iter) {
    if((i.iter%%50) == 0) {
      print(paste("We have run the first ", i.iter, " iterations",sep=""))
    }
    err<-tol+1

    ## compute posterior cluster membership
    clustlike<-matrix(0,xrow,K)
    for(j in 1:K) {
      clustlike[,j]<-log(p[j])+L[,j]
    }

    tempmax<-apply(clustlike,1,max)
    for(j in 1:K) {
      clustlike[,j]<-exp(clustlike[,j]-tempmax)
    }
    tempsum<-apply(clustlike,1,sum)


    ## update motif occurrence rate
    for(j in 1:K) {
      clustlike[,j]<-clustlike[,j]/tempsum
    }

    p.new<-(apply(clustlike,2,sum)+1)/(xrow+K)

    ## evaluate convergence
    err<-max(abs(p.new-p)/p)

    ## evaluate whether the log.likelihood increases
    loglike.new<-(sum(tempmax+log(tempsum))+sum(log(p.new)))/xrow

    loglike.old<-loglike.new
    p<-p.new

    if(err<tol) {
      break;
    }
  }

  ## compute posterior p
  clustlike<-matrix(0,xrow,K)
  for(j in 1:K) {
    clustlike[,j]<-log(p[j])+L[,j]
  }

  tempmax<-apply(clustlike,1,max)
  for(j in 1:K) {
    clustlike[,j]<-exp(clustlike[,j]-tempmax)
  }
  tempsum<-apply(clustlike,1,sum)

  for(j in 1:K) {
    clustlike[,j]<-clustlike[,j]/tempsum
  }

  p.post<-matrix(0,xrow,xcol)
  for(j in 1:K) {
    for(i in 1:xcol) {
      if(patid[j,i] > 0.5) {
        p.post[,i]<-p.post[,i]+clustlike[,j]
      }
    }
  }

  ## return
  #calculate back loglikelihood
  loglike.old<-loglike.old-sum(log(p))/xrow
  loglike.old<-loglike.old*xrow
  result<-list(p.post=p.post, motif.prior=p, loglike=loglike.old)
}

generatetype<-function(limfitted)
{
  jtype<-list()
  df<-limfitted$g1num+limfitted$g2num-2+limfitted$df0
  for(j in 1:limfitted$compnum)
  {
    jtype[[j]]<-list(f0=modt.f0.loglike, f0.param=df[j], f1=modt.f1.loglike, f1.param=c(df[j],limfitted$g1num[j],limfitted$g2num[j],limfitted$v0[j]))
  }
  jtype
}
## This is the main user-facing function
cormotiffit <- function(exprs, groupid=NULL, compid=NULL, K=1, tol=1e-3,
                        max.iter=100, BIC=TRUE, norm.factor.method="TMM",
                        voom.normalize.method = "none", runtype=c("logCPM","counts","limmafits"), each=3)
{
  # first I want to do some typechecking. Input can be either a normalized
  # matrix, a count matrix, or a list of limma fits. Dispatch the correct
  # limmafit accordingly.
  # todo: add some typechecking here
  # Setting runtype to only use either counts, logCPM, or limmafit inputs specified from defaults
  limfitted <- list()
  if (runtype=="counts") {
    limfitted <- limmafit.counts(exprs,groupid,compid, norm.factor.method, voom.normalize.method)
  } else if (runtype=="logCPM") {
    limfitted <- limmafit.default(exprs,groupid,compid)
  } else if (runtype=="limmafits") {
    limfitted <- limmafit.list(exprs)
  } else {
    stop("runtype must be one of 'logCPM', 'counts', or 'limmafits'")
  }

  ## Generating likelihood functions and creating statistical models of H0 and H1 distributions
  jtype<-generatetype(limfitted)
  fitresult<-list()
  ks <- rep(K, each = each)
  fitresult <- bplapply(1:length(ks), function(i, x, type, ks, tol, max.iter) {
    ## The below function runs the EM algorithm
    cmfit.X(x, type, K = ks[i], tol = tol, max.iter = max.iter)
  }, x=limfitted$t, type=jtype, ks=ks, tol=tol, max.iter=max.iter)

  best.fitresults <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(K)) {
    w.k <- which(ks==K[i])
    this.bic <- c()
    for (j in w.k) this.bic[j] <- -2 * fitresult[[j]]$loglike + (K[i] - 1 + K[i] * limfitted$compnum) * log(dim(limfitted$t)[1])
    w.min <- which(this.bic == min(this.bic, na.rm = TRUE))[1]
    best.fitresults[[i]] <- fitresult[[w.min]]
  }
  fitresult <- best.fitresults
## Chosing best K value, a lower BIC/AIC model indicates a better model
  bic <- rep(0, length(K))
  aic <- rep(0, length(K))
  loglike <- rep(0, length(K))
  for (i in 1:length(K)) loglike[i] <- fitresult[[i]]$loglike
  for (i in 1:length(K)) bic[i] <- -2 * fitresult[[i]]$loglike + (K[i] - 1 + K[i] * limfitted$compnum) * log(dim(limfitted$t)[1])
  for (i in 1:length(K)) aic[i] <- -2 * fitresult[[i]]$loglike + 2 * (K[i] - 1 + K[i] * limfitted$compnum)
  if(BIC==TRUE) {
    bestflag=which(bic==min(bic))
  }
  else {
    bestflag=which(aic==min(aic))
  }
  result<-list(bestmotif=fitresult[[bestflag]],bic=cbind(K,bic),
               aic=cbind(K,aic),loglike=cbind(K,loglike), allmotifs=fitresult)

}

cormotiffitall<-function(exprs,groupid,compid, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100)
{
  limfitted<-limmafit(exprs,groupid,compid)
  jtype<-generatetype(limfitted)
  fitresult<-cmfitall(limfitted$t,type=jtype,tol=1e-3,max.iter=max.iter)
}

cormotiffitsep<-function(exprs,groupid,compid, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100)
{
  limfitted<-limmafit(exprs,groupid,compid)
  jtype<-generatetype(limfitted)
  fitresult<-cmfitsep(limfitted$t,type=jtype,tol=1e-3,max.iter=max.iter)
}

cormotiffitfull<-function(exprs,groupid,compid, tol=1e-3, max.iter=100)
{
  limfitted<-limmafit(exprs,groupid,compid)
  jtype<-generatetype(limfitted)
  fitresult<-cmfitfull(limfitted$t,type=jtype,tol=1e-3,max.iter=max.iter)
}

plotIC<-function(fitted_cormotif)
{
  oldpar<-par(mfrow=c(1,2))
  plot(fitted_cormotif$bic[,1], fitted_cormotif$bic[,2], type="b",xlab="Motif Number", ylab="BIC", main="BIC")
  plot(fitted_cormotif$aic[,1], fitted_cormotif$aic[,2], type="b",xlab="Motif Number", ylab="AIC", main="AIC")
}

plotMotif<-function(fitted_cormotif,title="")
{
  layout(matrix(1:2,ncol=2))
  u<-1:dim(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.q)[2]
  v<-1:dim(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.q)[1]
  image(u,v,t(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.q),
        col=gray(seq(from=1,to=0,by=-0.1)),xlab="Study",yaxt = "n",
        ylab="Corr. Motifs",main=paste(title,"pattern",sep=" "))
  axis(2,at=1:length(v))
  for(i in 1:(length(u)+1))
  {
    abline(v=(i-0.5))
  }
  for(i in 1:(length(v)+1))
  {
    abline(h=(i-0.5))
  }
  Ng=10000
    ## bestmotif$p.post is one of the main outputs, which gives us the probability that each genes belongs to each motif. Basically the posterior probability for each gene to be differentially expressed in each study for the best fitted model
  if(is.null(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$p.post)!=TRUE)
    Ng=nrow(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$p.post)
  genecount=floor(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.p*Ng)
  ## bestmotif$motif.q is one of the main outputs, which gives the correlation pattern defining each motif. Basically the fitted values of the correlation motif matrix for the best fitted model
  NK=nrow(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.q)
  plot(0,0.7,pch=".",xlim=c(0,1.2),ylim=c(0.75,NK+0.25),
       frame.plot=FALSE,axes=FALSE,xlab="No. of genes",ylab="", main=paste(title,"frequency",sep=" "))
  segments(0,0.7,fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.p[1],0.7)
  rect(0,1:NK-0.3,fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.p,1:NK+0.3,
       col="dark grey")
  mtext(1:NK,at=1:NK,side=2,cex=0.8)
  text(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.p+0.15,1:NK,
       labels=floor(fitted_cormotif$bestmotif$motif.p*Ng))
}
```

## Cormotif Data Setup
```{r Data Setup}
# =========================================================
# 1. Setting up my PHTO data
# =========================================================

PHTO_metadata <- readRDS("data/Emma_metadata_updated_all.RDS")
PHTO_counts <- read.csv("data/Emma_counts_file.csv")

working_metadata_file <- PHTO_metadata %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!Stimulus %in% c("EtOH", "PFOA", "BPA")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time == 24) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Grouping = case_when(
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "DMSO" ~ "Chimp_DMSO",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "DMSO" ~ "Human_DMSO",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "H2O" ~ "Chimp_H2O",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "H2O" ~ "Human_H2O",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "DOX" ~ "Chimp_DOX",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "DOX" ~ "Human_DOX",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "NUTL" ~ "Chimp_NUTL",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "NUTL" ~ "Human_NUTL",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "TUN" ~ "Chimp_TUN",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "TUN" ~ "Human_TUN",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "THA" ~ "Chimp_THA",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "THA" ~ "Human_THA",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "LPS" ~ "Chimp_LPS",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "LPS" ~ "Human_LPS",
      Species == "C" & Stimulus == "TNFa" ~ "Chimp_TNFa",
      Species == "H" & Stimulus == "TNFa" ~ "Human_TNFa"
  )
)

raw_counts_file <- PHTO_counts %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(., Ensembl = gene_id) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-Ensembl, names_to = "Samples", values_to = "raw_counts") %>% 
  left_join(PHTO_metadata, by = c("Samples" = "Sample_ID")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Stimulus %in% c("EtOH", "PFOA", "BPA")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time == 24) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Ensembl, raw_counts, Final_sample_name) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Final_sample_name, values_from = raw_counts) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Ensembl")

filtered_raw_counts <- raw_counts_file[rowMeans(log2cpm)> 0,]
```

## Cormotif Following Steps
```{r Cormortif final setup}
# working_metadata_file %>%
#   distinct(
#     Species,
#     Stimulus
#   ) %>%
#   arrange(
#     Species,
#     Stimulus
#   )

stimulus_order <- c(
  "TNFa",
  "LPS",
  "H2O",
  "TUN",
  "THA",
  "DOX",
  "NUTL",
  "DMSO"
)

species_order <- c(
  "H",
  "C"
)

# ===================================================================================================================
# 2. I am validating my stimulus/species against metadata so that I don't have any typos or misinformation entering
# ===================================================================================================================

observed_stimuli <- sort(
  unique(working_metadata_file$Stimulus)
)

expected_stimuli <- sort(
  stimulus_order
)

if (!setequal(observed_stimuli, expected_stimuli)) {
  
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Stimuli names do not match.\n\n",
      "Observed in working metadata file:\n",
      paste(observed_stimuli, collapse = ", "),
      "\n\nExpected:\n",
      paste(expected_stimuli, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}


if (!setequal(unique(working_metadata_file$Species), species_order)) {
  
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Species names do not match expected values: ",
      paste(species_order, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 3. I am now reordering my working metadata file
# =========================================================

metadata_cmf <- working_metadata_file %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stimulus = factor(
      Stimulus,
      levels = stimulus_order
    ),
    Species = factor(
      Species,
      levels = species_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Stimulus,
    Species,
    Ind
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cond = paste(
      Species,
      Stimulus,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

# =====================================================================
# 4. I am now generating a condition/group assignment from my metadata
# =====================================================================

group_assignment <- metadata_cmf %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Stimulus,
    Species,
    Cond
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Stimulus,
    Species
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    groupid = row_number()
  )

# =========================================================
# 5. Add group IDs to metadata
# =========================================================

metadata_cmf <- metadata_cmf %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    group_assignment %>%
      select(
        Cond,
        groupid
      ),
    by = "Cond"
  )

group_id <- metadata_cmf$groupid

```

## Extracting Cormotif gene clusters based on clusterlike probability values
```{r Extracting clust_like gene sets}
#extracting the cluster likelihood probabilities that a given set of genes under a study belongs to a given motif cluster
PHTO_cmf <- readRDS("data/PHTO_cmf_species_Human_then_Chimp_stimuli.RDS")
expr <- readRDS("data/PHTO_expr_matrix_cmf.RDS")

clust_probs <- PHTO_cmf$bestmotif$clustlike
rownames(clust_probs) <- rownames(expr)
#converting to a dataframe
cmf_assignments <- as.data.frame(clust_probs) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Ensembl")

#now I am assigning each set of genes to a motif with max cluster likelihood probability
assign_clust <- apply(clust_probs, 1, which.max)
max_clust <- apply(clust_probs, 1, max)

#defining the probability cutoff number for motif assignments
prob_cutoff <- 0.5

#combine these into a dataframe - motif assigned genes (p.post)
cmf_assign <- clust_probs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Ensembl_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Max_Probability = pmax(V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8),
    #identify which column has the max value
    Assigned_Motif = max.col(dplyr::select(., starts_with("V")), ties.method = "first")
  ) %>%
  #only keep genes meeting our probability threshold of 50%, this being the genes with the highest confidence of belonging to a motif
  filter(Max_Probability >= prob_cutoff)

#make a list with each motif's genes included in a vector
clustlike <- cmf_assign %>%
  group_by(Assigned_Motif) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~paste0("motif_clust", .x$Assigned_Motif[1]))) %>%
  map(~.x$Ensembl_ID)

#check the lengths for all final motif gene sets
map_int(clustlike, length)

#now, check to see if any genes are not assigned in this set
assign_clust <- unique(unlist(clustlike))
prob_genes <- rownames(clust_probs)
unassign_clust <- setdiff(prob_genes, assign_clust)

length(unassign_clust)
length(prob_genes)
length(assign_clust)

#check that unassigned genes = total genes - assigned genes
if (length(unassign_clust) == length(prob_genes) - length(assign_clust)) {
  cat(sprintf("SUCCESS: unassigned = total - assigned. unassigned = %d\n", length(unassign_clust)))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("WARNING: unassigned != total - assigned. unassigned = %d\n", length(unassign_clust)))
}

```

## Gene Ontology GO:BP on genes in clusters pulled from Cormotif as a dot plot

```{r Gene ontology of gene clusters, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
#setting background ENSEMBL genes for GO:BP and KEGG analyses
bg_genes <- filtered_log2cpm_tmm_counts %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Ensembl") %>%
    pull(Ensembl)

#looping over the GO:BP and KEGG for each motif in 'clustlike_motif' object
motif_GO <- map(
    clustlike,
    ~gost(
        query = .x,
        organism = "hsapiens",
        custom_bg = bg_genes,
        domain_scope = "custom",
        significant = TRUE,
        correction_method = "fdr",
        sources = c("GO:BP", "KEGG")
    )
)

#this is to combine all motifs into one dataframe
motif_GO_df <-
    imap_dfr(
        motif_GO,
        function(res, motif){
            if(is.null(res$result))
                return(NULL)
            res$result %>%
                mutate(Motif = motif)
        }
    )

#plotting GO:BP and KEGG terms for each motif
motif_source_plots <- motif_GO_df %>%
  split(
    interaction(
      .$Motif,
      .$source,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ .x %>%
      slice_min(p_value, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        term_name = reorder(term_name, -log10(p_value))
      ) %>%
      ggplot(
        aes(
          x = -log10(p_value),
          y = term_name,
          size = intersection_size
        )
      ) +
      geom_point(
        color = ifelse(
          unique(.x$source) == "KEGG",
          "#2E8B57",
          "#5B4FA2"
        )
      ) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          unique(.x$Motif),
          unique(.x$source),
          sep = " - "
```

## Parsing Motif Clusters
### Reading in data
```{r File Reading}
metadata <- readRDS("data/PHTO_metadata_cmf.RDS")
filtered_log2cpm_tmm_counts <- readRDS("data/PHTO_expr_matrix_cmf.RDS")
look_up_table <- readRDS("data/PHTO_lookup_table.RDS")
toptable_results <- readRDS("data/PHTO_toptable_results.RDS")
```

### Reorganizing data for Heatmaps
```{r Data reorganization}
expression_table <- filtered_log2cpm_tmm_counts %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    var = "Ensembl"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::right_join(
    look_up_table %>% 
      dplyr::select(
        Ensembl,
        Symbol
      ),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    id_label = ifelse(
      is.na(Symbol),
      Ensembl,
      Symbol
    )
  )

metadata_ordered <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(
      Species,
      levels = c("C", "H")
    ),
    Stimulus = factor(
      Stimulus,
      levels = c(
        "H2O",
        "TNFa",
        "LPS",
        "DMSO",
        "TUN",
        "THA",
        "DOX",
        "NUTL"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Species,
    Stimulus,
    Ind
  )

make_motif_ordering <- function(
    motif_number,
    clustlike_motifs,
    expression_table,
    metadata
) {
  
  # Pulling the appropriate motif cluster
  motif_cluster <- clustlike_motifs[[
  paste0("motif_clust", motif_number)]]
  
  # Keep only genes belonging to that motif
  motif_genes <- expression_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Ensembl %in% motif_cluster
    )
  
  # Put samples in the metadata-defined order
  motif_ordering <- motif_genes %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Ensembl") %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(metadata$Final_sample_name)
    )
  
  return(
    list(
      cluster = motif_cluster,
      genes = motif_genes,
      ordering = motif_ordering
    )
  )
}

motif_results <- purrr::map(
  1:8,
  ~make_motif_ordering(
    motif_number = .x,
    clustlike_motifs = clustlike,
    expression_table = expression_table,
    metadata = metadata_ordered
  )
)

names(motif_results) <- paste0(
  "motif_",
  1:8
)
```

```{r Heatmaps LogFC setup, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
  purrr::map(
```

```{r Heatmap LogFC motif defining, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
make_motif_fc_matrix <- function(
    motif_name,
    motif_results,
    fc_table,
    fc_comparisons
) {
  
  motif_cluster <- motif_results[[motif_name]]$cluster
  
  fc_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Ensembl %in% motif_cluster
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      id_label = ifelse(
        is.na(Symbol),
        Ensembl,
        paste0(Symbol, " (", Ensembl, ")")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      id_label,
      dplyr::all_of(fc_comparisons)
    ) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(
      "id_label"
    ) %>%
    as.matrix()
}

motif_fc_matrices <- purrr::map(
  names(motif_results),
  ~make_motif_fc_matrix(
    motif_name = .x,
    motif_results = motif_results,
    fc_table = fc_table,
    fc_comparisons = fc_comparisons
  )
)

names(motif_fc_matrices) <- names(motif_results)
```

```{r Ongoing Heatmap analysis, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
make_motif_heatmap <- function(
    motif_name,
    motif_results,
    metadata
) {
  
  # =========================================================
  # 1. Pull genes and ordered expression matrix
  # =========================================================
  
  motif_genes <- motif_results[[motif_name]]$genes
  
  motif_ordering <- motif_results[[motif_name]]$ordering
  
  
  # =========================================================
  # 2. Z-score each gene across samples
  # =========================================================
  
  motif_scaled <- t(
    scale(
      t(
        as.matrix(motif_ordering)
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  # =========================================================
  # 3. Create gene-label lookup
  # =========================================================
  
  gene_labels <- motif_genes$id_label
  
  names(gene_labels) <- motif_genes$Ensembl
  
  
  # =========================================================
  # 4. Reorder metadata so it exactly matches heatmap columns
  # =========================================================
  
  metadata_heatmap <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::slice(
      match(
        colnames(motif_scaled),
        Final_sample_name
      )
    )
  
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(motif_scaled),
      metadata_heatmap$Final_sample_name
    )
  )
  
  
  # =========================================================
  # 5. Make annotation colors
  # =========================================================
  
  individual_levels <- unique(
    metadata_heatmap$Individual
  )
  
  individual_colors <- structure(
    colorRampPalette(
      RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
    )(
      length(individual_levels)
    ),
    names = individual_levels
  )
  
  
  stimulus_levels <- unique(
    as.character(metadata_heatmap$Stimulus)
  )
  
  stimulus_colors <- structure(
    colorRampPalette(
      RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2")
    )(
      length(stimulus_levels)
    ),
    names = stimulus_levels
  )
  
  # =========================================================
  # 6. Create heatmap annotation
  # =========================================================
  
  motif_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    Species = metadata_heatmap$Species,
    Stimulus = metadata_heatmap$Stimulus,
    Individual = metadata_heatmap$Individual,
    col = list(
      Species = c(
        H = "#D55E00",
        C = "#0072B2"
      ),
      Stimulus = stimulus_colors,
      Individual = individual_colors
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 8,
      fontface = "bold"
    )
  )
  
  # =========================================================
  # 7. Create heatmap
  # =========================================================
  
  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    
    motif_scaled,
    
    name = "Z-score",
    
    top_annotation = motif_anno,
    column_title = motif_name,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    row_labels = gene_labels[
      rownames(motif_scaled)
    ],
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 5
    ),
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(
      c(-2, 0, 2),
      c("blue", "white", "red")
    )
  )
}
```

### Working to display Log2cpm Boxplots of Motifs
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
make_motif_gene_averages <- function(
    motif_name,
    motif_results,
    metadata
) {
  
  motif_genes <- motif_results[[motif_name]]$genes
  
  # Define all Species x Stimulus groups from metadata
  group_lookup <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Group = paste(
        Species,
        Stimulus,
        sep = "_"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Samples = list(Final_sample_name),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Calculate mean expression for each gene in each group
  group_means <- purrr::map_dfc(
    seq_len(nrow(group_lookup)),
    function(i) {
      
      samples_i <- group_lookup$Samples[[i]]
      group_i <- group_lookup$Group[i]
      
      tibble::tibble(
        !!group_i := rowMeans(
          motif_genes %>%
            dplyr::select(
              dplyr::all_of(samples_i)
            ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      )
    }
  )
  
  dplyr::bind_cols(
    motif_genes %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Ensembl,
        Symbol
      ),
    group_means
  ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(
        Ensembl,
        Symbol
      ),
      names_to = "Group",
      values_to = "logCPM"
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
  Group = factor(
    Group,
    levels = c(
      "H_H2O",
      "H_TNFa",
      "H_LPS",
      "H_DMSO",
      "H_TUN",
      "H_THA",
      "H_DOX",
      "H_NUTL",
      
      "C_H2O",
      "C_TNFa",
      "C_LPS",
      "C_DMSO",
      "C_TUN",
      "C_THA",
      "C_DOX",
      "C_NUTL"
    )
  )
)
}
```

### Working to display Fold Change Boxplots of Motifs
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
combined_logFC <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  motif_fc_matrices,
  function(fc_matrix, motif_name) {
    
    fc_matrix %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = -Gene,
        names_to = "Comparison",
        values_to = "logFC"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Motif = motif_name,
        
        Species = dplyr::case_when(
          stringr::str_starts(Comparison, "H_") ~ "Human",
          stringr::str_starts(Comparison, "C_") ~ "Chimp"
        ),
        
        Stimulus = dplyr::case_when(
          stringr::str_detect(Comparison, "TNFa") ~ "TNFa",
          stringr::str_detect(Comparison, "LPS")  ~ "LPS",
          stringr::str_detect(Comparison, "TUN")  ~ "TUN",
          stringr::str_detect(Comparison, "THA")  ~ "THA",
          stringr::str_detect(Comparison, "DOX")  ~ "DOX",
          stringr::str_detect(Comparison, "NUTL") ~ "NUTL"
        )
      )
  }
)

combined_logFC <- combined_logFC %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(
      Species,
      levels = c("Chimp", "Human")
    ),
    
    Stimulus = factor(
      Stimulus,
      levels = c(
        "TNFa",
        "LPS",
        "TUN",
        "THA",
        "DOX",
        "NUTL"
      )
    ),
    
    Motif = factor(
      Motif,
      levels = paste0("motif_", 1:8)
    )
  )
```
